meta.name: Loan need signals: signs that a business or person needs a loan
meta.how_to_read: Each signal = something you can observe. 'means' = why it points to borrowing. 'loans' = PPCBank products from loan_products.json, best first. 'detect' = where you see it (public data or officer in the field). 'strength' = how reliable it is on its own. 'ask_on_visit' = the question that confirms it.

strength_scale.strong: Usually means a funding need within 0 to 6 months
strength_scale.medium: Often means a need; confirm with one more signal
strength_scale.weak: Context only; never send a lead on this alone

meta.privacy_rule: Business signals can be tracked per business, because businesses are public. Personal signals are used at the location or group level only (for example 'this new borey', 'this factory's workers', 'this Korean-language school'). Do not build profiles of named private individuals from public data.

business_signals.means: Owner spent heavily on fit-out and stock; now needs working capital or to refinance expensive informal money.
detect: Grand-opening banners or balloons spotted by officer
New Facebook or TikTok page with opening posts
business_signals.ask_on_visit: How did you fund the setup, and how much stock do you keep?

business_signals.means: Construction and equipment bills are coming now.
detect: Scaffolding or shutters with 'coming soon' signs
OSM building=construction at a business address
business_signals.ask_on_visit: What is the renovation budget and when do you open?

business_signals.signal: Opening a second or third branch
business_signals.means: Growth needs capital; a classic expansion loan.
detect: Same business name appears at a new location in OSM
Facebook posts announcing a new branch
Officer sees a known brand at a new site
business_signals.ask_on_visit: Are you planning more branches this year?

business_signals.signal: Always full, long queues, sold out early
business_signals.means: Demand is higher than capacity; owner needs more space, staff or equipment.
business_signals.ask_on_visit: If you had more space or another machine, could you sell more?

business_signals.means: Business is growing; payroll and working capital go up before revenue does.
detect: Repeated job posts on the business's Facebook page
Officer sees new uniforms or staff
business_signals.ask_on_visit: How many people are you adding and why?

business_signals.signal: Adding delivery or growing a vehicle fleet
business_signals.means: Needs to buy trucks, vans or cars.
detect: Rented vehicles in use (sign they want to own)
business_signals.ask_on_visit: Do you rent or own your vehicles, and how many do you need?

business_signals.means: Must buy stock before Khmer New Year, Pchum Ben, harvest or school season and gets paid later.
detect: Calendar: 1 to 2 months before big holidays
business_signals.ask_on_visit: When is your busiest season and how do you pay suppliers before it?

business_signals.signal: Sells on credit to customers (contractors, distributors)
business_signals.means: Cash is stuck in unpaid invoices, so it needs a revolving facility.
business_signals.ask_on_visit: How long do customers take to pay you?

business_signals.means: Pays suppliers abroad before selling locally.
detect: Trading office near port, dry port or border
business_signals.ask_on_visit: How do you pay your foreign suppliers now?

business_signals.means: Needs a guarantee and working capital to deliver it.
detect: Company Facebook posts about new projects
business_signals.ask_on_visit: Do you need a performance guarantee or upfront materials?

business_signals.means: Equipment purchase; term loan with grace period fits.
business_signals.ask_on_visit: What equipment are you planning to buy in the next year?

detect: Same name appears at a larger address
business_signals.ask_on_visit: Will you rent or buy the new place?

business_signals.signal: Online seller growing (Facebook or TikTok shop)
business_signals.means: Needs stock and packing space, but usually has no land title.
detect: Home address turning into a mini warehouse
business_signals.ask_on_visit: Do you own any titled property or keep savings in a fixed deposit?

person_signals.signal: New borey or condo project selling units
person_signals.ask_on_visit: Ask the developer: how many buyers still need financing?

person_signals.means: Construction bills now, often paid with costly short-term money.
person_signals.ask_on_visit: Is the land hard-titled? (required for this loan)

person_signals.signal: Workers at large employers (factories, malls, hospitals, hotels)
person_signals.means: Salaried people with payslips often need small urgent loans or a first car.
detect: Industrial zones and large employers in OSM
person_signals.ask_on_visit: Ask HR: is staff payroll paid through a bank, and which one?

person_signals.signal: People preparing to work in South Korea
person_signals.means: Need money for training, documents, flight and first months.
person_signals.ask_on_visit: Ask the school: how many students passed the exam and are waiting to depart?
When do students need to pay the first tuition?

person_signals.unit: per dealer (partnership; PPCBank has partner brands)
person_signals.ask_on_visit: Ask the dealer: what share of buyers pay by loan?

person_signals.signal: Car owners needing quick cash (Phnom Penh)
person_signals.means: Emergency need; car can secure the loan.
detect: Hard to see publicly; best via car insurers, repair shops and existing customers

person_signals.signal: Seasonal spending peaks (school fees, Khmer New Year, Pchum Ben, weddings)
person_signals.unit: timing for campaigns, not individual leads
person_signals.ask_on_visit: Use for timing of Telegram or HR campaigns.

red_flags_do_not_push.signal: Closing-down sale, 'for rent' or 'for sale' sign on the shop
red_flags_do_not_push.means: Business is exiting; any loan would be distress borrowing.

red_flags_do_not_push.signal: Shorter opening hours, empty shelves, staff leaving
Owner already borrowing from several lenders
red_flags_do_not_push.means: Possible over-indebtedness; check credit bureau at application, do not pitch more debt.

red_flags_do_not_push.signal: Business rents and has no titled property
red_flags_do_not_push.means: Not a red flag on demand, but most PPCBank business loans need a hard title; offer Business Car Loan or Loan Against Deposit instead.

how_to_get_high_accuracy.rule_1: Never send a lead on one weak signal. Send when there is 1 strong signal, or 2 medium signals.
how_to_get_high_accuracy.rule_2: Check red flags before sending. Any of R01 to R03 cancels the lead.
how_to_get_high_accuracy.rule_3: Re-check the business is still open right before sending.
how_to_get_high_accuracy.rule_4: Every visit result (Interested, Applied, No need, Closed, Wrong info) goes back into the system to correct which signals actually work.

best_combos.meaning: New and already busy: very likely to need capital to grow
New branch plus hiring: expansion underway
New borey near a large employer: salaried home buyers
Shophouse being rebuilt: home and business need at once
